description: This file defines the JobResolver class, which provides functionality to resolve job identifiers based on their short names by interacting with an external SchedulerJobApi. It uses Spring annotations for component declaration and caching, and employs Lombok for boilerplate reduction.

classes.name: JobResolver
classes.description: A Spring component that resolves the ID of a job based on its short name by calling an external scheduler API and caches the results.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves the ID of a given job by its short name using the SchedulerJobApi, with caching enabled.
